name: 71106 · Shreveport, LA
findings: ZIP 71106 (Shreveport) has 139 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 71106 (Shreveport) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 71106 (Shreveport) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
